The grout lines in the background tiles are inconsistent and wavy. The decorative medallion on the wall appears slightly melted into the tile texture rather than being a distinct applied object.
The fingers wrapping around the can show slight anatomical ambiguity. The thumb position is awkward, and the boundary between the skin and the can is slightly soft/blurred, suggesting minor fusion.
